description: This file contains utility functions for handling assignment fields, rendering HTML select elements, checking AOP (Aspect-Oriented Programming) enablement, retrieving email settings, and parsing templates within the SuiteCRM system, specifically related to AOP case updates.

methods.name: getAOPAssignField
methods.description: Generates HTML select elements for assigning roles or security groups based on provided values.

methods.name: getAOPAssignFieldDetailView
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the assignment field for display in detail view, including role and security group labels.

methods.name: isAOPEnabled
methods.description: Checks if AOP (Aspect-Oriented Programming) is enabled in the configuration.

methods.name: getPortalEmailSettings
methods.description: Retrieves email settings for portal notifications, falling back to admin settings if not explicitly configured.

methods.name: aop_parse_template
methods.description: Parses a template string, replacing placeholders with data from specified beans, handling custom fields.
